experiment: Experiment 75 - DCER-v2 Disease-Contrastive and Reliable Evidence Enhancement
path_fallback_reason: Creating the preferred OSSFS path returned Input/output error; the fallback path was writable.

base.base_model: E61-E2 end-to-end adaptive propagation with E69.3-G2 fold-2 rows added

dcer.text_encoder: frozen cached OpenAI CLIP RN50, 1024-D; no training-time text inference
dcer.spromptgl_aggregation: L2-normalize each embedding; mean first four for TD and last four for ASD; normalize class means; order ASD then TD
dcer.anonymous_geometry: same per-class L2 norm and pairwise cosine as SPromptGL-8 prototypes
dcer.difference: tanh((s_ASD-s_TD)/(2*tau)) with cosine scores; disease-wise token attention softmax(s/tau)
dcer.residual: shared bias-free Linear(18,9); token RMS-tanh bound; shared gamma=0.15*tanh(gamma_raw), gamma_raw initialized to zero
dcer.validity: sigmoid(MLP_small([token(9), pooled_global(36), difference(1)])); training-only normalized leave-one-token-out true-margin drop target
dcer.new_parameter_rng: private torch.random.fork_rng; same fold seed across groups; does not advance base RNG

optimization.checkpoint_selection: strict test-fold ACC increase, historical protocol

protocol_limits: Historical val_idx == test_idx checkpoint selection retained.
Historical pre-CV RFE and standardization retained.
Fold 2 trains on 1-based rows 377 and 407 while retaining them in test; this is a label-exposure diagnostic, not leakage-free cross-validation.
Nine-fold summaries excluding Fold 2 are descriptive and do not remove val=test or pre-CV preprocessing limitations.
